base.description: A single cartoon fire flame icon: orange outer flame, yellow middle, white hot core, pointed tip curling up, no logs, no wood, no campfire, just the flame. Clean chunky pixel art icon, centered, transparent background, no text.

animation.action: The fire flame flickers and dances in place: the tips sway left and right and stretch up and down, the bright core pulses. The flame stays the same size, same position and same colours, seamless loop, no smoke, no sparks.

sprites.processing: Alpha cut at 128, pixels below the ground line of the first frame removed, a generated shadow under the flag base removed, the first eight frames packed side by side as a looping sprite sheet. The logs under the generated flame were removed and a one pixel dark outline was added before animating.
